newsitem.title: USA: Perot Systems offers to buy Nets Inc - report.
newsitem.headline: Perot Systems offers to buy Nets Inc - report.

text.p: Perot Systems Inc has offered to buy the remaining assets of Nets Inc, the bankrupt Internet commerce company headed by for Lotus Developments Chief Executive Jim Manzi, for $9 million cash, the Boston Globe reported Friday.
Perot Systems put its proposal to the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Boston, where Nets filed for Chapter 11 protection last month, the newspaper said.

Attorneys for Nets said the Perot Systems offer is the best they have received from potential investors, the Globe said. The court will hold a hearing on June 17 on the Perot Systems offer, the newspaper said.
Officials from Nets were unavailable for comment.
